## Graduate Conference for Research, Scholarship, and Creative Activity

**Georgia State University · Atlanta, Georgia · November 18, 2026**

I presented our research, *Cancer Classification in Low- and High-Dimensional Biomedical Data Using Machine Learning Models*, at Georgia State University’s Graduate Conference for Research, Scholarship, and Creative Activity.

The study examines machine learning for cancer classification using Breast Tissue and DNA-methylation data. It emphasizes the importance of evaluating model reliability when the available sample is small relative to the number of features.

I am grateful to my co-authors, [Mandy Ash](https://www.linkedin.com/in/mandy-ash/) and Sujay Datta, for their contributions and support, and to [Georgia State University](https://www.linkedin.com/school/georgiastateuniversity/) for organizing the conference.

[Read the preprint](https://doi.org/10.20944/preprints202608.0073.v1){.paper-link} [View the project](https://github.com/Enock-ackaah/cancer-classification-low-high-dimensional-data){.paper-link}
